app.name: ProMedia
control.adSlotHint: Set VITE_GAM_NETWORK_CODE and VITE_GAM_AD_UNIT for live ads.
control.projectionOnSecondary: Output opened on the other monitor (fullscreen requested if the browser allows).
control.projectionOpened: Output opened. If it is not on the 2nd monitor or fullscreen, drag it and press Fullscreen.
control.dragHint: Drag the output window to the 2nd monitor or projector and enter fullscreen.
control.playlistEmpty: Use the tabs to add a link, Bible, text, or song; or + for files
control.popupBlocked: Popup blocked. Allow popups or open this URL:
control.sceneLogoHint: Click: project logo (opens the file picker if none is saved yet) · Right-click / double-click / Alt+click: upload permanent image
control.sceneLogoUpload: Upload or replace the logo image (also used as the watermark)
control.sceneLogoSaved: Logo saved (also used as the watermark)
control.sceneLogoBadType: Use an image (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, or SVG)
control.sceneLogoLarge: Large image: may be slow on LAN
control.sceneWatermarkHint: Show the same logo in the top-right corner of the projection (10% of width)
control.dotsOverlayHint: Toggle the dot pattern that darkens video
output.fullscreenHint: Use the button or F11 for fullscreen. Esc to exit.
text.slidePlaceholder: Write the text. A blank line separates phrases (each phrase is a slide)…
text.importLimits: Limits: PDF/XML/txt/md · max 8 MB · up to 200 slides · 6 lines per projection slide · ~900 chars per block. Manual editor still available.
text.importUnsupported: Unsupported format. Use PDF, XML, .txt or .md.
image.largeWarning: Large file: may saturate LAN or browser memory (no hard size cap).
video.youtubeInvalid: Invalid YouTube URL or missing videoId.
video.youtubeCaveat: YouTube needs internet on Control and Output. Some videos block embed. Unmuted autoplay may require a click in the browser.
video.fileCaveat: Codecs: mp4 and webm. QuickTime (.mov) with warning — may not play in all browsers. No hard size cap.
video.quicktimeWarning: QuickTime (.mov): may not play in all browsers.
video.largeWarning: Large video: may saturate LAN or browser memory (no hard size cap).
theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Theme controls text typography, colors, and alignment on Output. Image/video only use the canvas background.
theme.bgDotsHint: Darkens the background with dots so light text stays readable
playlist.saveFileHint: Opens your device’s file explorer to save a .promedia-guion.json you can reload later.
playlist.loadFileHint: Pick a previously saved schedule file (.promedia-guion.json or .json).
playlist.savedEmpty: None on this hub — use Open file…
playlist.loadedSkipped: Loaded (skipped {n} file items without assets in this session)
shortcuts.hint: Shortcuts: G Go Live · O Open output · L/B/C/N scenes · 1/2/3 themes · ←/→ karaoke lyrics (or slides) · Start projection CTA · Double-click schedule = live
control.wsDisconnectedHint: WebSocket disconnected — playlist cannot sync. Reconnecting… or click Reconnect.
control.wsConnectingHint: Connecting to hub… If it stays closed, ensure `pnpm dev` has the hub on :8787.
control.hubUnreachable: The hub is not running. Open Terminal in the promedia folder and run: pnpm dev
control.envIssuesHint: Install or fix what is listed; the hub keeps working without it.
control.shareProjectionHintPc: 1) On this PC tap Project. 2) On the phone open the Control link (same Wi‑Fi). 3) Go Live on the phone appears on the PC projection.
control.shareProjectionHintPhone: This phone controls the PC projection. Use Go Live — you don’t need Output on the phone.
control.shareProjectionHintPcReady: Projection is open on this PC. Open the Control link on the phone (same session); phone Go Live shows here.
control.phoneControlsPcHint: Projection is on the PC. Use Go Live on the phone; you don’t need Project here.
control.pairBody: Join the PC session. Enter the code shown on the computer’s Control/Output (same Wi‑Fi).
control.pairFailed: Could not join. Check the code and Wi‑Fi.
control.sessionCodeHint: Phone and projection must use this same code
output.pairHint: On the phone open Control and enter this code to sync
video.youtubePasteHint: Paste a public YouTube link and press Add.
bible.hintEdit: Change the verse range and save to update the schedule item and projection.
bible.apiFailed: Could not fetch the passage (API or network). Try another version or later.
bible.hint: Free versions: RV1909, PDT, KJV, ASV. RVR1960 not included (copyright).
bible.hintFast: Enter or “Add to schedule” sends the passage straight to the schedule (no preview).
playlist.addFilesTip: Choose or drag any file (image, video, audio, PDF, PPTX, text, …)
playlist.addMoreTip: Link, YouTube, Bible, text, song, audio, or Library
playlist.addTabs: Options to add to the schedule
playlist.addAudioTip: Upload music or audio (mp3, wav, m4a, aac, flac, ogg…)
playlist.dropFiles: Drop any file here to add it to the schedule
playlist.dropHint: Drag files of any type onto this column.
playlist.genericFileAdded: File added to the schedule as a reference
link.hint: YouTube becomes a video item. Any other http(s) URL is saved as text with the link.
link.invalid: Invalid URL. Use http:// or https://, or a YouTube link.
control.subtitleAgentTitle: Karaoke agent: on YouTube/audio load, download media, match cancionero lyrics, place cues on real silence with 0.20 s air before the word. Fallback: captions/Whisper clocks only. No match → modal.
control.subtitleAgentYoutube: YouTube: Control-language captions (manual ≫ auto) as-is; if missing, audio + Whisper `-l`. Needs yt-dlp + ffmpeg.
control.subtitleAgentNativeReady: Native captions ready (YouTube track, official timing)
control.subtitleAgentCancioneroSynced: Karaoke synced: cancionero lyrics + real silence (−0.20 s air)
control.subtitleAgentSilenceScan: Downloading and scanning the video for real silence…
control.cancioneroNoMatchTitle: Song not found in the song library
control.cancioneroNoMatchBody: This song was not found in the cancionero (Library → Songs). Add it or import a QSP. The karaoke agent will not invent lyrics with Whisper for Audio/YouTube — the song library is the source of truth.
control.cancioneroNoSongsBody: The Library has no songs. Import a Quelea song pack (.qsp) or create a song under Library → Songs, then toggle Karaoke agent again.
control.cancioneroEmptyBody: A matching song was found, but it has no usable lyrics. Edit the stanzas under Library → Songs.
control.subtitlePrepareTitle: Aligns every song in the Guion now (one after another) so lyrics show instantly when you go live. Do it before projecting.
control.subtitleSaveLyricsTitle: Saves the lyrics found on LRCLIB to the Library, marked as “suggested” for you to review.
control.subtitleLyricsSaved: Lyrics saved to the Library (suggested: please review)
control.subtitleLyricsExists: A song with that title already exists in the Library; not overwritten
control.subtitleLyricsSaveFailed: Could not save the lyrics to the Library
library.songSuggestedHint: Lyrics downloaded from LRCLIB (community database): review them before using in public.
control.cancioneroTeachHint: Pick the correct songbook entry. The agent will remember it for this video/audio next time.
control.cancioneroTeachEmpty: No songs yet. Import a QSP or create one under Library → Songs.
control.subtitleAgentDepsMissing: Install yt-dlp, ffmpeg, and whisper-cpp (`brew install yt-dlp ffmpeg whisper-cpp`) and restart ProMedia.
control.subtitleAgentYtDlpMissing: Install yt-dlp and ffmpeg (`brew install yt-dlp ffmpeg`) and restart ProMedia.
control.subtitleAgentFfmpegMissing: Install ffmpeg (`brew install ffmpeg`) and restart ProMedia.
control.subtitleAgentExtractFailed: Could not extract audio (incomplete download or codec). Try again, or install/update ffmpeg (`brew install ffmpeg`).
control.subtitleAgentModelDownload: Could not download the Whisper model (network needed once). Check connectivity and retry.
control.subtitleAgentModelPath: Whisper model path error. Install whisper.cpp (`brew install whisper-cpp`), restart ProMedia, and ensure the hub uses whisper-cli (not ONNX).
control.subtitleAgentWhisperCppMissing: No whisper-cli. Local alternate: drop an .srt/.vtt into promedia/data/subtitles/sidecars/ named like the media file, or use YouTube with captions. Or `brew install whisper-cpp` and restart.
control.subtitleAgentWhisperCppFailed: whisper.cpp transcription failed. Check ggml under promedia/data/models/whisper/ or reinstall. Alternate: SRT/VTT in data/subtitles/sidecars/.
control.subtitleAgentYoutubeAge: Age-restricted YouTube video — could not download audio
control.subtitleAgentYoutubePrivate: Private or login-required YouTube video — could not download
control.subtitleAgentYoutubeFailed: Could not download YouTube audio (private, blocked, or offline)
control.subtitleAgentTextOnly: No audio — text-only song or item
control.subtitleAgentNoItem: Select a local video/audio or a YouTube item
control.subtitleAgentLocalTracksReady: Subtitles ready (local SRT/VTT sidecar or embedded softsubs)
control.subtitleAgentNoSpeech: No usable lyrics (sound labels only or empty ASR). Try YouTube with captions, an SRT/VTT in data/subtitles/sidecars/, or reinstall whisper-cpp + ggml-base.
control.subtitleAgentSourceOnly: ASR ready; local MT unavailable for this pair — showing source language
control.subtitleAgentLead: Subtitle lead: signed offset vs the clock (−3…0 s). Negative shows lyrics early. Timed agent cues only — not manual song ←/→ slides.
control.aboutBody: ProMedia — multimedia projection. Author credits and contact.
control.notificationsEmpty: No messages yet — WS, projection, and errors appear here.
library.title: Library
library.hint: Local hub media library (songs, bibles, texts, presentations, images, videos). Data stays on disk; no cloud in this phase.
library.empty: Library empty — upload files or create a song.
library.songEditorHint: Save lyrics as one block (one line per row). The karaoke agent syncs each phrase to the voice.
library.bibleHint: Copyrighted Bibles stay on this machine (data/library/). Not committed to Git. After import, pick the version in Schedule → Bible.
library.bibleImportOk: Bible imported into the local library.
library.songHint: Quelea song packs (.qsp) and XML stay on this machine (data/library/). Not committed to Git. After import, add them to the Schedule as text.
